interpretation.sample: Three alternating before/current independent processes; three observations per operation per process, nine pooled per version/operation.
interpretation.workload: 10000 mixed file/workshop/URL tag identifiers plus one real target file and 10000 unrelated progress records; separate 10240 path keys across 1280 file headers/eight real Windows junctions. interpretation.observed: Modern tag reads and replacements lost 10001 mistaken namespace-to-path resolutions. Favorite/network operations avoid unrelated config snapshots. Legacy tag latency did not materially improve and its maximum heartbeat was worse in these samples.
interpretation.jsonCounts: Whole-state parses identify full configuration roots. Zero does not mean zero JSON parsing or zero full tag-field copies. Parsed character totals count JavaScript input string lengths in controlled main JSON.parse, not UTF-8 bytes or worker allocations.
interpretation.excluded: Initial development before/after fixture results retained but excluded from final series. Final counter recognizes resolved identifier paths, and captured dependency ordering is explicit; final assertions validate this.
interpretation.notEstablished: Cold startup, long-run P95, renderer input latency, native decoding contention, peak/PSS/long-run memory or full release readiness.

incident.cause: Existing test imported network-resources before process.chdir(tempRoot), pinning Node fallback data to the project. Its later temporary cwd was ineffective.
incident.transcodeScope: The same test created/force-cleared transcode cache through this fallback. Prior cache inventory was not captured; any preexisting removed files cannot be reconstructed from this observation.
incident.priorContents: No pre-test content backup captured for settings/identity/metadata/index. Do not speculate restoration.
incident.scope: Project Node fallback only; test did not target ordinary Electron app.getPath(userData). Current files retained.

correctedRerun.conditions: Fixture entered before any production import; user-data assertion before writes and full project fallback content hash inventory unchanged after the production HTTP library/transcode/pairing test.

isolation.status: Existing remote-library verifier imported a main dependency before changing cwd and modified project Node fallback settings/identity/metadata/index and used its transcode cache. Pre-write contents/cache inventory not captured. Current files retained, no speculative restoration/deletion. Fixed the test to enter/assert fixture before every production import and preserve a full fallback content inventory. New media-fields tests themselves assert fixture paths and hashes. Junction fixtures retained.

limits: Old path keys remain bounded but individually re-resolved; no cached assumption removes fresh alias/permission checks. Legacy workload remains about 0.49 seconds.
Tag callback fields still include whole tag/revision tables and writes still normalize/encode complete fields/file. Single-entity map transactions and indexing/migration remain future work.
Initial/recovery/legacy full settings returns and other IPC responses remain; complete configuration/progress repository responsibility separation is not claimed.
Selected-field callback API does not provide a new crash or cross-file transaction guarantee; original synchronous rebase/follow-up-write semantics retained.
R6 physical decode/contention/rotation/PSS; R7 remaining repository/feature/type/cold-stability work; R8 dependency/migration/recovery/signing/update/TLS remain open.
